page.content:
Novelist and screenwriter of The Exorcist.

How William Peter Blatty connects

  • Topic: The Exorcist — William Peter Blatty created The Exorcist as a novel and screenplay.
  • Work: The Exorcist (novel) — Blatty wrote the 1971 novel.
  • Work: The Exorcist (1973) — Blatty wrote the screenplay for the 1973 film.
  • Work: The Exorcist III — Blatty wrote and directed The Exorcist III.

What is William Peter Blatty?

William Peter Blatty wrote the 1971 novel and the film's screenplay, then later directed The Exorcist III from his Legion novel.

Key threads lead to The Exorcist, The Exorcist (novel), The Exorcist (1973) and The Exorcist III.
